title: Grok Build is "not allowed" by default; Stop Coder button is full width
body:
Owner, 2026-10-01 06:23, Mac app 063044d929:
1. "do a test delegation to grok" → "You asked for Grok Build; it is not one of the engines your Coder settings allow, so Codex is running." Grok support landed (#10052) and Grok is installed and signed in on the owner's Mac, but with no `~/.openagents/settings.json` the defaults are `default_providers()` = Codex, Claude Code only (`crates/coder/src/task/settings.rs`). Grok must be allowed by default (order: Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build — an engine that isn't signed in is skipped anyway with a plain reason). Show Grok in the desktop sidebar engine rows and Settings → Coder when installed. Decide Devin/OpenCode defaults explicitly (OpenCode needs a model; Devin is a paid API) and document. Keep the rule that a broken settings file never becomes an opt-in. Update INVARIANTS/docs/knowledge entries that list the defaults.
2. The transcript's **Stop Coder** button spans the full transcript width while Coder runs. Make it content-sized like the phone (or rely on the composer's stop control if that's the design) — consistent with #10075's button sizing.

Add release-gate scenarios: `delegate-grok` (Grok Build starts and finishes on a real engine, when installed/signed in on the gate machine; FAIL not skip unless `--allow-missing-engine`) and a check that the running Stop Coder control is content-sized.
